title: Fancy Meeting You Here

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Hello again. I see you've made it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello again. I see you've made it.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Please do. I'll wait.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please do. I'll wait.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: I'd be surprised. Seems a waste to make it this far and lose out now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd be surprised. Seems a waste to make it this far and lose out now.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Finish your job and make the drop. Then I'll entertain your questions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Finish your job and make the drop. Then I'll entertain your questions.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: My naive friend, you've been complicit since you first spoke to Ms Weiss. It is your face on the security feeds afterall.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My naive friend, you've been complicit since you first spoke to Ms Weiss. It is your face on the security feeds afterall.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: It's not me you would have to convince. Make the drop and join our nest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not me you would have to convince. Make the drop and join our nest.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: It's a lovely spot, no? Something about the water, and the way the... I'm sorry, I just can't keep a straight face when I attempt appreciation of physical beauty. Now, what brings you here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a lovely spot, no? Something about the water, and the way the... I'm sorry, I just can't keep a straight face when I attempt appreciation of physical beauty. Now, what brings you here?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: A thriving business owner such as yourself? I'm sure you have plenty of places to be and yet here you are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A thriving business owner such as yourself? I'm sure you have plenty of places to be and yet here you are.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: You don't deserve to hold the coin in your pocket. Give it to me you worthless little runt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't deserve to hold the coin in your pocket. Give it to me you worthless little runt.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Be careful what you eat. Those pills turn to powder pretty easily. All this surveillance and tracking and yet the old ways still sting just as hard.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Be careful what you eat. Those pills turn to powder pretty easily. All this surveillance and tracking and yet the old ways still sting just as hard.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Good. I knew they were right about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. I knew they were right about you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you been here the whole time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you been here the whole time?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you been here the whole time?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you been here the whole time?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Had no where else to be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Had no where else to be.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Had no where else to be.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Had no where else to be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Was told to drop this off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Was told to drop this off.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Was told to drop this off.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Was told to drop this off.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if I don't want to?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if I don't want to?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What if I don't want to?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What if I don't want to?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What am I missing out on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What am I missing out on?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What am I missing out on?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What am I missing out on?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: First, tell me something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: First, tell me something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I do I'm complicit in what your bodyguards did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I do I'm complicit in what your bodyguards did.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I do I'm complicit in what your bodyguards did.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I do I'm complicit in what your bodyguards did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All we did was talk!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All we did was talk!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's bullshit. Alexandria killed her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's bullshit. Alexandria killed her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: OK.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: OK.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gladly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gladly.
